description: This Java class 'ContentManagementWorker' provides utility methods for managing content entities within the OFBiz framework, including caching, permission checks, content hierarchy updates, and retrieval of related content and publish points.

classes.name: ContentManagementWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for content management operations within OFBiz.

methods.name: mruAdd
methods.description: Adds a content entity to the most recently used cache in the session.

methods.name: mruAddByEntityName
methods.description: Adds a primary key signature to the LIFO set cache for a specific entity name.

methods.name: mostRecentlyViewedIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the most recently viewed entities for a given entity name.

methods.name: buildPKSig
methods.description: Constructs a string signature from a primary key or entity, optionally with a suffix.

methods.name: setCurrentEntityMap
methods.description: Stores a given entity in the session's current entity map.

methods.name: getFromSomewhere
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from paramMap, request attribute, or context.

methods.name: getCurrentValue
methods.description: Retrieves and caches the current entity value based on request parameters.

methods.name: getCurrentValueWithCachedPK
methods.description: Determines the current primary key and value based on cached and passed keys.

methods.name: getPermittedPublishPoints
methods.description: Filters publish points based on user permissions and returns permitted ones.

methods.name: getAllPublishPoints
methods.description: Retrieves all publish points related to a parent publish point.

methods.name: getPublishPointMap
methods.description: Creates a map of content IDs to publish point entities.

methods.name: getAllPublishPointMap
methods.description: Recursively populates a map with all publish points under a parent.

methods.name: getStaticValues
methods.description: Retrieves static content values associated with a parent placeholder, filtered by permitted publish points.

methods.name: getWebSitePublishPoint
methods.description: Fetches a WebSitePublishPoint entity, optionally ignoring cache.

methods.name: overrideWebSitePublishPoint
methods.description: Overrides a WebSitePublishPoint with its parent if applicable.

methods.name: getParentWebSitePublishPointValue
methods.description: Retrieves the parent WebSitePublishPoint content entity.

methods.name: getParentWebSitePublishPointId
methods.description: Gets the parent WebSitePublishPoint ID from ContentAssoc.

methods.name: getStaticValue
methods.description: Retrieves static value for a placeholder, considering cache.

methods.name: getPublishedLinks
methods.description: Retrieves links published under a content ID, considering permissions.

methods.name: getAuthorContent
methods.description: Fetches author content related to a given content ID.

methods.name: getPermittedDepartmentPoints
methods.description: Filters department points based on user permissions.

methods.name: getAllDepartmentContent
methods.description: Retrieves all department content entities related to a parent publish point.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Gets the full name of a user given their login ID.

methods.name: updateStatsTopDown
methods.description: Recursively updates content statistics from top to bottom.

methods.name: updateStatsBottomUp
methods.description: Recursively updates content statistics from bottom to top.
